per_seed_hierarchy_support_requires_all: K3 full_order_correct is strictly greater than K2 full_order_correct
K2_wrong_K3_correct is strictly greater than K2_correct_K3_wrong
mean true-candidate endpoint error ratio K3/K2 is strictly less than 1
K3 prefix-depth-3 correct is not lower than K2 prefix-depth-3 correct
K3 pairwise-precedence correct is not lower than K2 pairwise-precedence correct
degree_1_control: report mathematical candidate-signature non-identifiability under singleton-only interactions; do not infer chronology from floating tie-breaking

recency_baseline.name: B2_marginal_stage_loss_recency
recency_baseline.definition: at each final endpoint, evaluate completion loss separately on A/B/C/D; predict oldest-to-newest by descending final stage loss under the ordinary monotone-forgetting hypothesis

strong_interaction_specific_support_requ: pooled K3 full_order_correct is strictly greater than pooled recency full_order_correct
pooled K3 prefix-depth-3 correct is strictly greater than pooled recency prefix-depth-3 correct
pooled K3 pairwise-precedence correct is strictly greater than pooled recency pairwise-precedence correct
if_primary_passes_but_recency_not_beaten: accept only the narrower interaction-order hierarchy result; do not claim nontrivial chronology forensics beyond ordinary recency/capability evidence
if_primary_fails: do not move to 31M; treat K3 hierarchy as non-replicating and redesign or pivot before further scale compute
if_primary_and_strong_support_pass: the controlled Pythia-14M result is paper-relevant but still simulator-assisted and synthetic; next priority is a semantic or less-transcript-dependent validation rather than immediate parameter-scale escalation
margin_rule: report all margins without post-hoc thresholding; exact zero is non-identifiable
